proof_scope: adversarial: the #1224 failure class — wedged build locks and stale dist — must self-recover or fail closed with a structured receipt, never hang

claims.proves: a wedged (D-state) lock holder is rotated automatically with a recovered:true receipt and the build proceeds; a live lock holder is never rotated and times out with a structured build_lock_timeout receipt; the hot path is bounded
claims.does_not_prove: Chrome extension reconnection behavior (needs a live browser) or real D-state process handling (simulated via SURF_TEST_LOCK_HOLDER_STATES)

cases.name: wedged-lock-rotates-automatically-and-build-proceeds
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf; V=vendor/surf-cli; ( exec 9>$V/.ensure-surf-cli-build.lock; flock 9; sleep 25 ) & H=$!; sleep 1; touch $V/native/host.cjs; SURF_TEST_LOCK_HOLDER_STATES=D SURF_CLI_BUILD_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3 timeout 200 scripts/ensure-surf-cli.sh 2>&1; rc=$?; kill $H 2>/dev/null; exit $rc

cases.name: live-lock-holder-is-never-rotated
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf; V=vendor/surf-cli; ( exec 9>$V/.ensure-surf-cli-build.lock; flock 9; sleep 15 ) & H=$!; sleep 1; touch $V/native/host.cjs; SURF_TEST_LOCK_HOLDER_STATES=S SURF_CLI_BUILD_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3 scripts/ensure-surf-cli.sh 2>&1; rc=$?; kill $H 2>/dev/null; scripts/ensure-surf-cli.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $rc -eq 75 ] && echo LIVE_LOCK_PRESERVED; exit 0

cases.name: hot-path-tab-list-bounded-and-fast
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/surf && start=$(date +%s); timeout 30 ./run.sh tab.list --json >/dev/null; rc=$?; end=$(date +%s); echo "rc=$rc elapsed=$((end-start))s"; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && [ $((end-start)) -le 20 ] && echo HOT_PATH_BOUNDED
